in_sanskrit.name: Ato
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Breath, Vital Force
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ato एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ato is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘atma’ meaning self or soul. In Hinduism, it symbolizes the vital breath or the life force that sustains all living beings. The name is often used in spiritual contexts to invoke the divine presence within.
